_about: The Vitra server's tools (MCP /v1/mcp and REST /v1/agent/tools), by toolset, generated from the server's buildRegistry(). validate.mjs checks every listing.yaml `mcp-tools` name and `mcp-toolset` against it, and tests/tool-names checks every tool a SKILL.md names. `titles` and `arguments` are each tool's title and argument names. Regenerate it whenever the server adds, renames or removes a tool.
